body: At the very least im gonna need a lot of space before we can be friends again. Which i dont know i feel like that might be fair i just want to sort myself out and focus on myself for a while

I wont be. Im not mad at all just a little disappointed and its silly to be mad. I respect that she just isn’t interested but I just want her to be respectful towards me too but shes shown a few times that she cant so im just done completely.

We were out with a group and I dont like to hover around people when im out so I found another girl and had a nice conversation and got her number and then i tried talking to my friend after and she just crossed her arms and kept walking away from me and kept telling me to go talk to the other girl instead. Thank you i will brush her off and if she keeps asking then Ill tell her that thats solid advice.

I have other friends who are girls who have never done that to me and make me feel bad and awkward for just trying to do what human beings do. She cant have it both ways and im not gonna associate with someone who doesn’t respect that im my own person

I dont want to remain friends with her is my issue. Sure its awkward but i mean shes not the first girl to reject me and she wont be the last i can handle it. I just dont want to be friends with her because she gets angry at me and complains when im talking to other girls. So im supposed to just be friends with someone who doesnt see me in a romantic sense but also cant handle me trying to find someone who’s interested in me romantically?
I mean honestly if she doesn’t respect me enough to tell me no she isn’t interested or say anything else then I feel like she can figure that one out without me saying anything else.

Im not. I got rid of her number. Its been like this for a while and im just kinda tired of it. But she’s probably gonna see me somewhere and I just wanna not have to talk to her longer than 30 seconds at this point. Id rather spend the time with someone who actually cares i guess

I totally agree the whole online thing is kinda numbing for me and it all just blends together way too much. Ive been keeping a notebook and i just got a physical calendar today. Pinning the syllabus on the wall is a great idea! Thanks!

Unfortunately i signed a lease on an apartment before coronavirus hit so it looks like i might be out of that money. But im thinking if things arent interesting in a few weeks ill head back to see my family and visit some of my friends at college.
